source.title: Irish News, 3 June 1955, p. 1 ("Rural councils: Coleraine"); Derry Journal, 3 June 1955, p. 1 ("Rural Council election results in Co. Derry"); Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1955, p. 7
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Citation confirmed by reading the page (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026): INW 3 Jun 1955 p1 'Hervey Hill. Kilrea - J. Hutchinson (outgoing member) 220; J. Patterson, 121; majority, 99'; DYJ 3 Jun 1955 p1 the same (garbled OCR); BNL 3 Jun 1955 p7.

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. Two of the 21 divisions were contested (Derry Journal, 3 June 1955, p. 1; Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1955, p. 7). Hutchinson, J.P., was the outgoing member.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Hervey Hill (Kilrea)' to Hervey Hill (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Coleraine Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Hervey Hill; the rounds were filed as Hervey Hill (1924, 1927, 1930, 1933, 1939, 1946, 1949, 1952, 1958, 1961); Hervey Hill (Kilrea) (1955). This round was filed as 'Hervey Hill (Kilrea)', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (hervey-hill-kilrea) answers with a redirect to this one.
